name: critic.5valid5invalid
note: EVERY REVERT IN THIS FIXTURE IS REAL. The items are simulated against the deployed
MockRewardDistributor at MOCK_DISTRIBUTOR_ADDR on Base Sepolia, whose state was read
before this file was written: root = 0xa1a1…a1 (SET), funded = 250000000, market 1
ENABLED, markets 2-9 disabled. So `setRoot` genuinely reverts RootAlreadySet(),
`enableMarket(1)` genuinely reverts MarketAlreadyEnabled(), and everything else
genuinely succeeds. Nothing is staged, and the eval calls the real simulate rather
than reading an expected verdict out of this file.
THE CHAIN STATE THIS DEPENDS ON: markets 7, 8 and 9 are used by the valid items
precisely because Convoy's own fixtures never touch them — the 3-item run uses market
1 and the 12-item GATE 2 batch uses 1-6. An executed run cannot invalidate this
fixture. The eval simulates only, so it changes no state itself.
The four veto reasons are covered by different mechanisms on purpose:
would_revert by the simulator, over_budget by arithmetic, and evidence_mismatch and
unmet_dependency by the Critic — the two the simulator cannot see, which is the whole

items.label: valid — funds exactly what the evidence names
items.evidence: Epoch 42 distribution. The finance sheet totals 250.000000 USDC across the claim set, and that is the amount to fund against the published root. Root was set at the start of the epoch, so funding is unblocked.

items.label: valid — opens a market the evidence asks for
items.evidence: Open market 7 for claiming. The distribution is funded, which is the only precondition enableMarket has. Ops confirmed market 7 is in scope for this epoch.

items.label: valid — unremarkable, and unremarkable must not be vetoed
items.evidence: Market 8, same as market 7. Nothing special about it.

items.label: valid — a second, smaller top-up the evidence separately authorises
items.evidence: Late-claim window. Finance approved an additional 75.000000 USDC on top of the main distribution, in the thread of 2026-08-01. This is a separate top-up and is expected to be a second fund call, not a replacement for the first.

items.label: valid — closes the epoch
items.evidence: Open market 9, closing out the epoch-42 release. Funded, in scope, signed off.

items.label: invalid — duplicate; the market is already enabled onchain
items.evidence: Open market 1 for claiming. Carried over from the previous epoch's checklist; nobody noticed it had already been opened.

items.label: invalid — a second root; the root is already set onchain
items.evidence: Publish the epoch root. Copied in from the previous epoch's sheet by mistake — the root for this epoch was already published at the start of the window.

items.label: invalid — funds 2x what the evidence names; simulates perfectly
items.evidence: Fund the epoch-42 distribution. The claim sheet totals 250.000000 USDC — that is the figure finance signed off and the figure the claim set adds up to. Fund that amount against the published root.

items.label: invalid — the evidence explicitly holds this action back
items.evidence: Market 2 is NOT part of this release. Legal have not signed off the market-2 audit, and until that sign-off lands market 2 must stay closed. Do not open it in this run — it is listed here only so the batch is a complete picture of the epoch.

items.label: invalid — costs more than the plan allocated to it
items.evidence: Open market 3. Ops flagged this one as low priority and it was given a token allocation in the plan on the understanding it would be dropped if it did not fit.
